assets.author: KindleWake project

assets.license_evidence: Repository source history; no third-party image, font, sound or external asset was used
assets.notes: Adds Maelin Tidecaller, Kellan Ashward, Nyra Briar and Orin Lantern to the 16-choice protagonist gallery. The four 512x512 SVG portraits use Godot-compatible gradients and paths without filters. Each gallery choice carries presentation, face, hair, skin, build and sprite_accent metadata. The animated field/battle renderer translates those cues into a per-profile face, hair silhouette, skin palette, build detail and chest accent; animation poses remain shared by presentation.
